messages:
rachel: Kicking off canary for 2.0.0 -> 15% traffic (global). Deploy-bot asked us to watch slo/embeds and alerts channel.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=embeddings v=2.0.0 -> 15%. Preflight checks passed. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/s/rollouts/2.0.0

obs-bot: Alert: route:/v1/embeds 5xx_rate increased from 0.05% to 0.9% in eu-west (5m window). SID: alert-8923

nate: I see spike on 5xx that correlates with canary hosts. traces show upstream grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. Not CPU/GPU.

claire: stack shows new compiler passes in 2.0.0 changed retry behavior for batched calls. Could be inflating deadlines on long batch windows.

rachel: Are clients sending larger batch sizes in eu-west? Any change to batching config?

nate: No config change client-side. But canary nodes default batch_window_ms was tuned to 60ms in this release (was 40ms). That increases tail time for some requests.

rachel: quick decision: reduce canary traffic to 0% for eu-west, keep global canary at 5% (non-eu-west). We'll pin eu-west to v1.9.x. ops-bot, can you apply route constraint?

ops-bot: Executing traffic constraint: service=embeddings, region=eu-west, target_version=1.9.x, set traffic 100% -> 1.9.x.

ops-bot: Constraint applied. Canary traffic in eu-west set to 0% for v2.0.0. Global canary remains at 5%.

obs-bot: Note: 5xx rate decreased to 0.06% in eu-west after constraint. p95 latency also trending down.

claire: I'll prepare a quick canary variant with batch_window_ms=40 and re-run perf harness against seq_len>1024 and long prompts.

rachel: Good. Also add a deployment checklist item to include batch-window sweep for varied batch sizes and heavy tail IO. Add to release notes: default batch_window_ms change and impact.

nate: created ticket ENG-RUNTIME-2145, assigned to eng-runtime with priority P1 for postmortem and automated smoke tests.

rachel: Thanks. Keeping this thread for timeline and rollout notes. :white_check_mark:
